newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank of HK FRCD increased.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank of HK FRCD increased.

text.p: Union Bank of Hong Kong Ltd's floating-rate certificate of deposit issue has been increased to HK$550 million from HK$500 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said on Friday.
The five-year certificates can be put and called at the end of year three and four.
The issue was priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 65 basis points.
Arrangers and bookrunners are Schroders Asia and Jardine Fleming Bank.
Co-arrangers are Bank Austria's Hongkong branch and Westdeutsche Landesbank.
Development Bank of Singapore is senior manager.
Managers are Banco Central Hispanoamericano, Den Danske Bank's Hongkong branch, Hongkong Chinese Bank, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Ka Wah Bank.
Signing is tentatively set for end-May.
